verdict.rationale: The only documented opt-out covers model training: users can opt out of having their Materials used for AI training at app.instinct.com/settings, and Vault contents are excluded from training. Related controls are data deletion and access revocation, not tracking opt-outs. Nothing in the pack describes opting out of telemetry, analytics or usage tracking itself, so this only glancingly touches the story. Missing for 10: an explicit telemetry/usage-tracking opt-out, documentation of what usage data is collected, and hands-on or independent confirmation that any opt-out works.
